cause_quote: The new desktop Details rule for `.session-progress-card__step` added `align-items: center;`, centering the marker vertically across the full height of a wrapped description.
user_saw: In the desktop chat Details panel, task status icons appeared halfway down wrapped descriptions instead of beside the first line.
summary: The fix restores first-line alignment in the Details checklist, gives status icons a fixed-width column, and connects the steps with a vertical rail.
reasoning: In the parent commit, the existing Details checklist used `align-items: start`, and the browser test checked first-line alignment for wrapped descriptions. PR #176406 overrode that CSS on desktop and changed the test to expect the marker at the center of the entire description. The fix removes the override and restores the first-line assertion.
